description: Phase D: replace .container { overflow-x: hidden } (forces overflow-y to compute as auto, silently clips, creates a scroll container) with overflow-x: clip, in ONE separate commit that can be reverted alone. Depends on FEAT-003 (baseline for D is snap-C-final) and FEAT-002 (decides whether the deduped file can be rebuilt or the app-theme.css override variant is used). Key risk: clip does not create a block formatting context (margin collapse, floats) and unlocks sticky; prove nothing visible changes at 320/375/768/1024 on every page, otherwise DROP the phase and report why.
steps: Locate every .container overflow-x declaration in hand-written CSS (styles.css, possibly one copy left after C) and in the minified deduped file; list other .container rules (app-theme.css, formularz-page.css) to confirm none sets overflow.

Pre-checks in Edge via a throwaway script: browser.version(), CSS.supports('overflow-x','clip'), computed overflow-y is 'visible' with overflow-x:clip; enumerate descendants of .container with computed position:sticky on all pages/viewports (if any, DROP unless intended and shown by e2e specs, and report).

Create tmp-css-snapshot-rects.js (copy of tmp-css-snapshot.js adding rounded getBoundingClientRect x,y,w,h for every element and scrollHeight/clientHeight of each .container). Capture $env:TEMP\css-consolidate-1\snap-rects-before BEFORE editing (and snap-D-base with the normal harness equals snap-C-final).

Edit: hand-written .container blocks get 'overflow-x: hidden;' then 'overflow-x: clip;' (fallback pair for Safari<16), or remove the declaration if an extra capture proves it unneeded. If FEAT-002 regenerated the deduped file, run npm run build:css in the same commit (verify cssnano kept the fallback or use clip alone and note it). If FEAT-002 took the frozen fallback, ALSO add '.container { overflow-x: clip; }' with an explanatory comment to public/app-theme.css (pages without app-theme.css, i.e. index/register/intro/maintenance, keep old behaviour: document it). Edit via the EOL-preserving Node approach only.

Proof: tmp-css-compare.js snap-C-final vs snap-D --allow overflow-container exits 0 and the plain compare shows only .container overflow-x/overflow-y cells; rect snapshots before/after have ZERO differences at 320x640, 375x812, 768x1024, 1024x768 on every page and state; a scroll-to-bottom check at 375 wide shows scrollWidth === clientWidth; npm run test:e2e -- no-horizontal-overflow passes plus the canary.

If any unexplained rect/scroll/sticky/e2e difference appears: git revert the commit (or never commit), set findings to DROPPED with element, viewport, property. Otherwise commit only the CSS files: fix(css): use overflow-x clip on .container.
acceptance_criteria: The change is a single commit touching only CSS files (and the regenerated deduped file only if FEAT-002 proved regeneration), so git revert <sha> undoes it
Snapshot compare with --allow overflow-container exits 0; the only differing cells are .container overflow-x and overflow-y
Rect-level comparison at 320/375/768/1024 on every page and state shows zero differences; no sticky element lives inside a .container (or it is reported and the phase dropped)
npm run test:e2e -- no-horizontal-overflow passes; Edge CSS.supports('overflow-x','clip') recorded with the browser version
If dropped, findings explains exactly which element/viewport/property differed and the tree has no D changes
verification: npm run test:e2e -- no-horizontal-overflow smoke wrapping a11y  (green)
findings:
DROPPED. Phase D (.container overflow-x hidden -> clip) was NOT committed; the tree has no D changes (HEAD 7ef3839, both edited CSS files restored with git checkout, nothing pushed, no cr).

WHY: clip removes the block formatting context that overflow:hidden gave .container, so child margins now collapse through it and the layout shifts. Rect-level snapshot (snap-rects-before vs snap-rects-after, 14 pages x 4 viewports + states + scrolled-bottom, plain compare, overflow props not sampled) = 1,620 differing cells. Clean (0 diffs at all 4 viewports): activity, archiwum, index, intro, maintenance, recipients, register, rezerwacje. Diffs at all 4 viewports on: formularz, home, leaderboard, osoby, ustawienia, wiadomosci.
Examples (rect x,y,w,h before -> after; property = layout box height/position, caused by the lost BFC and the bottom/top margin of the first/last child escaping the .container):
- osoby@375x812 base: html scrollHeight 2489 -> 2469 (-20px); div.container.mt-4.mb-5 rect 0,32,375,2409 -> 0,32,375,2389. osoby@1024x768: 1846 -> 1826.
- ustawienia@375x812: document height 1558 -> 1538; div.container.mt-4.mb-5 height 1374 -> 1354. @1024x768: 1273 -> 1253.
- wiadomosci@375x812: 995 -> 975; div.container.mt-4.mb-5 811 -> 791. @1024x768: 865 -> 845.
- home@375x812: document height 3042 -> 3034; div.container rect 0,96,375,2842 -> 0,102,375,2814 (shifted down 6px). @1024x768 body and div.container moved y 0 -> 12.
- leaderboard@375x812: div.container rect 0,0,375,4708 -> 0,15,375,4678 (moved down 15px). @1024x768: 0 -> 30.
- formularz (all states incl. composer-add-mode/toggled): div.container height 1535 -> 1503 @375x812 (-32px), 1716 -> 1684 @1024x768, 1644 -> 1612 @320x640, 1492 -> 1460 @768x1024; document scrollHeight unchanged on formularz and leaderboard.
So the page content moves or the page gets shorter by 6-32px: a visible change, not an intended one. Per the hard rule the phase is dropped. The sticky check was clean but moot: 0 position:sticky elements on any page/viewport/state (inside or outside .container). Computed-overflow side was as intended.

PRE-CHECKS (all passed): Edge 155.0.4283.45 (playwright channel msedge); CSS.supports('overflow-x','clip') = true; computed overflow with overflow-x:clip = clip/visible, with hidden = hidden/auto, with the pair hidden;clip = clip/visible. Hand-written .container overflow-x is only at public/styles.css:1558 (one block after Phase C); styles.deduped.min.css has one frozen copy; app-theme.css:250 (max-width only, in @media) and formularz-page.css:216 (margin-top) and :191 (.top-menu-container .container {overflow:hidden}) are other .container rules. 128 container cells per snapshot set.

VARIANT TESTED: frozen-deduped override variant (FEAT-002 froze the deduped file): styles.css block got 'overflow-x: hidden; overflow-x: clip;' and public/app-theme.css got '.container { overflow-x: clip; }' (with a comment). Pages without app-theme.css (index, register, intro, maintenance) would have kept the old behaviour. Both edits reverted.

ALTERNATIVES (not done, would be a product decision): keep overflow-x:hidden (status quo, no visible change); or replace it with a BFC-preserving, margin-containing alternative such as 'display: flow-root' plus overflow-x: clip, which would also keep the margins inside; that needs its own rect proof and was out of scope here.

EVIDENCE (C:\Users\matmamon\AppData\Local\Temp\css-consolidate-1): snap-rects-before, snap-rects-after, cmp-rects.txt (full compare, exit 1), D-dropped-evidence.txt (per page summary), precheck-D.txt, stk.txt (sticky scan: 0). The normal-harness snap-D capture was aborted (not needed once the rect proof failed), so the --allow overflow-container compare and the e2e run were not executed. Untracked temp tools added: tmp-css-snapshot-rects.js, tmp-css-d-precheck.js. snap-C-final stays the reference for FEAT-005/finalisation; the final snapshot compare vs css-baseline must be plain (zero diffs), not --allow overflow-container.
